name: March of the Valkyr grants a raid-wide 3% damage aura and 5% parry (#756)
contract: March of the Valkyr 560534 is family 33, Attributes 64 (SPELL_ATTR0_PASSIVE) with EquippedItemClass -1 and no Stances, so it self-applies on learn. Effect 0 is SPELL_EFFECT_APPLY_AREA_AURA_RAID (65) targeting TARGET_UNIT_CASTER (1) with EffectRadiusIndex 287 and ApplyAuraName SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE (79), EffectBasePoints 2 + DieSides 1 = 3; Spell::EffectApplyAreaAura is the native, generic handler for effect 65 and is already used by many other raid-wide buffs, spreading a linked aura instance of the same spell to every raid member within radius. Effect 1 is SPELL_AURA_MOD_PARRY_PERCENT (47) on the caster, EffectBasePoints 4 + DieSides 1 = 5, a plain native stat aura. Neither effect needs a script: this is not "no server-side implementation". melee_damage_done queries player->MeleeDamageBonusDone(target, 1000, ...), which folds SPELL_AURA_MOD_DAMAGE_PERCENT_DONE into DoneTotalMod, so a fresh fixture with no other percent-damage modifiers goes from 1000 to exactly 1030 once it holds the spread aura; parry_chance reads the native percentage field directly, so it moves by exactly 5 points.

steps.label: Let spawn AI and level scaling settle
The nearby grouped ally receives the same aura
The grouped ally's damage rises by 3% from the spread aura
